text:
leah-marketing: Quick sync — MicroConf is in 6 days. Final checklist for onboarding kits + speaker lane assignments. Need final counts for swag, who can staff the demo lane, and confirmation on the benchmark one-pager we hand out.

aj: I can own the demo lane staffing. I have two folks (me + rita) on Thurs 9am-2pm. Need to confirm laptop image for the benchmark.

leah-marketing: Awesome, thanks aj. Jonah — can you confirm the benchmark narrative? We want 90s talking points + a 1-page cheat sheet for attendees.

jonah: Working on a trimmed narrative. Draft bullets: 1) what makes Redwood fast (routing + KV cache), 2) cost controls (batching/quant), 3) reliability fallbacks. Will add a tiny regen example.

emily: For swag counts: current order draft from vendor: 200 stickers, 120 tees, 40 hoodies, 150 quickstart cards. We should reduce tees to 100 and add 50 sticker sheets to hand out with demos. Thoughts?

samir: Reduce tees to 100 = :thumbsup:. Swap 20 hoodies for 20 drawstring bags? Easier to pack and more universal.

leah-marketing: I prefer bags over hoodies for travel. OK: stickers 250 (single+sheet mix), tees 100, hoodies 20, bags 20, quickstart cards 150. Update vendor now, emily?

emily: On it. Placed a change request to vendor -> ETA: 4 days for production, shipping 1 day. Link to PO: https://orders.example.com/po/MC-2319

ops-bot: Shipping manifest created. Pick-up window: 2024-06-18 16:00-18:00 at Warehouse B (dock 3). 

warehouse: Confirmed. We will stage kits and have 2 people for pickup. Please send final packing list by EOD.

leah-marketing: Packing list (final):
```
- 250 stickers (mix singles + 50 sticker sheets)
- 100 tees (S-XL mix)
- 20 hoodies (L/XL mostly)
- 20 drawstring bags
- 150 quickstart cheat sheets (folded)
- 2 demo laptops (redwood-bench image) + chargers
- 1 hotspot + spare battery
- 50 lead-capture cards (QR for lead routing)
```

aj: For the demo laptops, please confirm the image tag: redwood-bench:v3.2.2 (includes the small benchmark harness + local logs). I tested on Friday, looks good.

jonah: Benchmark one-pager draft is here: https://docs.redwood.ai/microconf/bench-onepager (please review). Key callouts: median p50 latency, token/unit cost table, fallback model behavior.

leah-marketing: Great. Also need copy for the booth header: short phrase for the panel and the demo lane. Draft: "Predictable inference at production scale — see it in 90s." Approve?

emily: Approve. Suggest adding a subline: "Live demo + cost/latency breakdowns."

samir: Also set up lead routing QR. Post-demo, capture email + role + interest. Route leads -> HubSpot list: microconf-demo-2024. Can we send an automated follow-up email with the one-pager + benchmark link?

leah-marketing: Yes. Scheduler: add follow-up automation to HubSpot: 1) immediate thank-you, 2) 24h follow-up with one-pager + quick trial link, 3) 7d ask for feedback/demo. Jon, can you draft the immediate email?

jonah: Drafted. Short: "Thanks for stopping by — here's the 90s benchmark + trial link." Will send to leah for copy edit.

emily: Small ops note — we need printed name badges for speakers (4) + staff (3). Leah, can you confirm names for printing?

leah-marketing: Names: Leah M, Aj P, Jonah K, Rita S, Emily T, Samir G, Maria S. Send to warehouse for badge prints.

ops-bot: Badge print job queued. Pickup: same dock at 16:00.

leah-marketing: Anything else? We still need 1 volunteer to cover the demo lane Friday afternoon (2-5pm). Anyone?

aj: I can extend to cover Friday 2-4pm if needed. Rita can take 4-5.

emily: I'll be there morning shift, can help with restock.

leah-marketing: Perfect. I've captured tasks: swag change placed, vendor eta confirmed, packing list sent to warehouse, demo image tag confirmed, one-pager link shared, HubSpot automation drafted. Closing notes: let's meet 12:30pm day-before for final sign-off at the booth. :calendar: 

samir: Added to calendar. See you all. :rocket:
